title: How much does an AI financial advisor cost in 2026?
summary: An AI financial advisor costs $0 to a few thousand dollars a year. See 2026 prices for Astor, Wealthfront, Betterment, Origin and Range at $50k and $250k.
body_markdown:
### How much does Astor cost?


Astor is free to start, with no card required. Pro is $19 a month or $10 a month billed yearly ($120 a year), and Max is $29 a month or $19 a month billed yearly ($228 a year). It’s a flat subscription, never a percentage of your assets. See[pricing](https://www.astor.app/#pricing) .


### Is there a free AI financial advisor?


A few services have a free option. Astor’s free plan needs no card and includes one custom alert. Among robo-advisors, Schwab Intelligent Portfolios charges no advisory fee with a $5,000 minimum, and Fidelity Go charges no advisory fee under $25,000. Free services can still have costs, like fund expenses, and some earn revenue in other ways that they disclose.


### Is a 0.25% fee a lot?


It’s $2.50 a year for every $1,000, so $125 on $50,000 and $625 on $250,000. That’s low next to the roughly 1% median a human advisor charges a $1 million client, according to Kitces Research. Whether it’s a lot depends on what it buys, which for a robo-advisor is a managed portfolio.


### Do robo-advisor fees include fund expenses?


No. Wealthfront and Betterment both say the expense ratios of the funds in your portfolio are separate from, and in addition to, their advisory fee. Check each fund’s expense ratio to see your full cost.


### How much does a human financial advisor cost?


Kitces Research puts the median asset-based fee at about 1% for a $1 million client, or $10,000 a year, with lower rates on larger portfolios. Advisors who bill by the hour charge about $300 an hour on average, and flat-fee advisors had a median of $4,500 a year in 2024. Many advisors who charge a percentage also set an asset minimum.
